I'm not running any bustling subs myself, but the most important thing I have noticed about keeping a sub running is to pick a subject that you love and are capable of posting about for weeks on end. Some subs are just lucky and take off immediately, but for most it is a long grind until the subscriber numbers hit critical mass and can sustain itself. That grinding period is where you have to fill in the content by yourself. That's why it is important to pick a subject you can post endlessly about. If the content isn't fresh no one is going to bother subscribing because they don't want to subscribe to a dead subverse.
